name: Skip Opening Cutscene
description: Auto-skips the power-on / attract opening cutscene (the scene that plays after "Nintendo Presents", before the title screen). Does NOT skip the new-game prologue (see "Skip Prologue") or boss cinematics.
details: The opening cutscene runs in game modes $05-$07, reached only by the boot/attract increment chain (nothing sets gm$05 explicitly). Two in-place edits: gm05 ($0F:BDFB) no longer queues the cutscene music (STA PlayMusic -> NOP x3), and gm07's render branch is repointed so the first frame advances straight to gm$08 instead of rendering - the BEQ CODE_0FBEE5 offset at $0F:BED2 ($12) becomes $00, so both the taken and fall-through paths land on CODE_0FBED3 (INC gamemode). Renamed from the former "flutter-skip-story-cutscenes" (which only ever affected this opening cutscene, not story cutscenes generally).
asm: ; --- Flutter: skip the power-on / attract opening cutscene (game modes $05-$07) ---
org !CODE_gm05_load_cutscene+$3D : db $EA,$EA,$EA   ; NOP gm05's 'STA PlayMusic' so no cutscene music is queued
org !CODE_gm07_cutscene+$18 : db $00                ; gm07: BEQ CODE_0FBEE5 offset $12 -> $00, so frame 1 advances to gm$08 (skip render)
